Footer.description: Free / confidential / non-judgmental. A service of hadit.ca, Quebec.

hero.subtitle: Whatever you're carrying drop it here. You can contact us for confidential support.

ways.subtitle: You can reach out to us for confidential support.

chat.title: Live chat
chat.body: Tap the chat. Talk to a real person, anonymously.

phone.title: Phone
phone.body: Hear a voice on the other end. Sometimes that's what helps most.

text.title: Text
text.body: Message us when you're ready. We'll meet you there.

email.title: Email
email.body: Write as little or as much as you want. No subject required.

notInCrisis.you: I'm not in crisis. I shouldn't take up space.
notInCrisis.us: You don't need to be in crisis. If something's sitting heavy, that's enough.

anonymity.you: I don't want my name on anything.
anonymity.us: You don't have to give one. Chat, text, and email are anonymous by default.

confidentiality.you: What if you tell my family / partner / boss?
confidentiality.us: We don't. The only exception is immediate risk to life — and we'll walk you through what happens.

dontKnowWhatToSay.you: I don't even know what to say.
dontKnowWhatToSay.us: Start with one word. "Hi." "Tired." "Stuck." We'll take it from there.

justVent.you: I just want to vent, not get advice.
justVent.us: Then vent. We're trained to listen, not to fix.

reallyFree.us: Yes. No fees, no insurance, no follow-up marketing. Ever.

options.subtitle: We'd rather you reach someone than wait. Both of these are free, confidential, and staffed by professionals.

infoSocial.title: 811 — Info-Social
infoSocial.body: Quebec's psychosocial helpline. Dial 811, choose option 2. Available 24 hours a day.

telJeunes.title: Tel-jeunes
telJeunes.body: Free, confidential support for young people. Phone, text, and chat.

about.p1: We work in collaboration with RAPS, a multi-disciplinary team offering services that include social support, community engagement, psychotherapy, psychiatry, and access to medical services.
about.p2: In conjunction with regional partners, we provide support to individuals and families throughout Québec who are affected by the present social climate, which causes distress to many.

hours.a: Phone: 8 a.m. to midnight, every day. Email and text are monitored 24 hours and we reply within a day. Live chat is open whenever a responder is online — usually during phone hours.

languages.a: We respond in English and French. Let us know which you prefer when you reach out — or just write in whichever feels easier.

location.q: Do I have to live in Quebec?
location.a: No. We're based in Quebec but we won't turn you away if you're elsewhere. We may suggest a service closer to you if it's a better fit.

afterReachOut.q: What happens after I reach out?
afterReachOut.a: A trained responder reads or answers your message and replies. There's no intake form, no diagnosis, no referral pipeline. You decide what happens next.

callback.q: Will you call me back if I don't answer?
callback.a: Only if you explicitly asked us to. Otherwise we wait for you to come back when you're ready.

notTherapy.q: Are you a replacement for therapy or a crisis line?
notTherapy.a: No. We're a place to be heard. If you're in immediate danger, please call 911. For ongoing care, 811 (option 2) can connect you with longer-term services.

funding.a: We operate as a not-for-profit service. There's no cost to you and no third party gets your information.
